complete_examples.text: Clearly from Fig. 1(a) vs. 1(b), at low dosage (5%) of rapeseed straw ash to replace the equivalent amount of cement, the changes in the concrete microstructure are small; and when the straw ash dosage is increased to 15%, marked differences are noted in the concrete microstructure, which is transformed from a dense type to a discontinuous, large-porosity loose structure system.

This situation could be attributed mainly to the fact that the addition of large straw ash substitution amounts has resulted in a change in microstructure, such as porosity, which in turn decreased the bite-force of concrete.

Afterward, these ballast particles are compacted to the porosity of 0.37, it is equivalent to a density of 1.75 g/cm 3 for the ballast layer, which meets the requirement of the “Chinese Code for Design of High Speed Railway” [12] .
